$preflightWatch = @'
const fs=require('fs');const file='.dip-local/production-frozen/.dip-local/production-agent-preflight-v3.json';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));console.log(JSON.stringify({started:r.startedAt,completed:r.completedAt,passed:r.passed,rows:r.rows.map(x=>({arm:x.arm,completed:x.completed,tools:x.retrieval.map(y=>y.tool),failedTools:x.toolEvents.filter(t=>t.type==='mcp_tool_call'&&t.status==='failed').map(t=>t.tool)})),error:r.error}));
'@
node -e $preflightWatch
Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object FreePhysicalMemory,FreeVirtualMemory | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
